one_line: Sultan of Bengal (1494–1519), who expanded his realm through hard-fought frontier campaigns and rooted the sultanate deeper in Bengali administration and literary culture.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, medium height, sturdy but not bulky build
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, warm medium-brown Bengali complexion, neat black beard trimmed close along the jaw with a slightly longer pointed chin, straight nose, calm intense eyes with a thoughtful gaze, default expression composed and firm with a hint of strategist’s focus
appearance.hair: straight black hair kept relatively short and tidy, mostly hidden under a tall slightly tapering dark green quilted turban-wrapped cap with a folded cloth band in deep maroon around the base and a small gold finial at the top
appearance.costume: He wears a long slightly fitted Persianate jama (robe) reaching just above the ankles, made of rich matte cream-coloured cotton with subtle woven vertical stripes and narrow cuffed sleeves, fastened diagonally from right shoulder to left hip with a row of small gold buttons; over this is a sleeveless waist-length deep maroon velvet-like over-robe with simple gold edging that suggests authority without ostentation. Around his waist is a broad dark green cloth kamarband sash wrapped twice and knotted to one side, from which hangs a small leather pouch; his lower garment is loose straight-cut trousers in muted olive, tucked into simple soft brown leather shoes with gently upturned toes. The overall textile look is 15th–16th century eastern Indo-Islamic court style: cotton and silk blends, fine but practical, with minimal patterning beyond subtle stripes and narrow gold borders on cuffs, hem, and over-robe.
appearance.signature: A single slightly curved steel talwar with a plain disc pommel and cross-guard, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with understated brass fittings, worn at his left hip and often held lightly in his right hand as a symbol of command rather than aggression.

ref_desc: Alauddin Husain Shah is a sturdy medium-height man in cream striped jama, deep maroon sleeveless over-robe, dark green sash, olive trousers and brown shoes, with an oval medium-brown face, neat black beard, dark green turban-cap, and a sheathed curved steel talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Alauddin Husain Shah: a sturdy, medium-height man in his early forties with an oval medium-brown Bengali face, straight nose, calm intense eyes, and a neat black beard trimmed close along the jaw with a slightly longer pointed chin. His straight black hair is short and almost entirely covered by a tall, slightly tapering dark green quilted turban-wrapped cap, with a folded deep maroon cloth band at the base and a small gold finial at the top. He wears a long cream-coloured cotton jama reaching just above the ankles, subtly striped vertically, with narrow cuffed sleeves and a diagonal closure from right shoulder to left hip secured by small gold buttons. Over this is a sleeveless waist-length over-robe of deep maroon, with simple gold edging along its opening and hem. A broad dark green cloth sash is wrapped securely around his waist and knotted to one side, from which a small brown leather pouch hangs. His trousers are loose, straight-cut, in muted olive, tucked into plain soft brown leather shoes with gently upturned toes. At his left hip, attached to the sash, is his signature weapon: a slightly curved steel talwar in a dark brown leather scabbard with modest brass fittings, which he lightly grips with his right hand in a composed, commanding manner. Use a restrained palette of cream, deep maroon, dark green, olive, and brown leather, and pose him frontally with additional side views to clearly show the face, turban-cap, layered garments, sash, and sword placement.
